enable_daemon.description: Enable or disable the regolith-powerd service.

lock_screen_timeout.description: Time in seconds before the screen is locked.

suspend_timeout.description: Time in seconds of inactivity before the system suspends.

hibernate_timeout.description: Time in seconds of inactivity before the system hibernates. Set to 0 to disable.

inhibition_reasons.description: List of systemd-inhibit reasons to block, allowing Sway/swayidle to manage power events instead of logind directly.

idle_action.description: Action to take when idle timeout is reached. Options: lock, suspend, hibernate, blank.

idle_timeout.description: Time in seconds of inactivity before the idle_action is triggered.
